prompt: 为一个从未听说过中文网络梗的文生图模型，写一条独立完整的提示词，让它画出长颈鹿版的「大笑奶龙」（Laughing Nailong / 奶蛙）表情包。只输出提示词。
answer: A cute 2D cartoon illustration in meme-sticker style of a giraffe-themed version of the viral Chinese internet mascot "Laughing Nailong" (大笑奶龙, also called 奶蛙). Base character: a plump, round, pale creamy-yellow creature with a small dragon-like look, short stubby arms and legs, a little curled tail, and a wide, frog-like mouth. Giraffe transformation: a long, slender giraffe neck rising from its chubby round body, orange-brown giraffe spots across the yellow skin, two short ossicone horns with dark tufts on top of the head, and rounded giraffe ears. Expression: laughing uncontrollably, head tilted back, eyes squeezed shut into happy upward-arched lines, a huge open-mouthed toothy grin, rosy blush on the cheeks, a few small tears of joy flying off the face, body bouncing with laughter. Cute and goofy, not scary. Style: clean bold outlines, flat bright saturated colors, minimal soft shading, expressive and funny, high resolution. Composition: single character, centered, full body, plain white background, no text, no watermark, no extra characters or props, no photorealism.
